title: Watermark PDF – Add Text or Image Watermark, No Upload
description: Add a text or picture watermark to a PDF in your browser, with opacity, rotation, position and the pages you choose. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Watermark PDF
subtitle: Put a text or picture watermark on every page, or the pages you choose, with your own opacity and angle; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Add a watermark to a PDF online: type text such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT in any language, or use your logo, then set its size, colour, opacity and angle, place it in one of nine positions or repeat it across the page, and choose the pages. A live preview shows the result, and nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Text or picture
features.text: Type words such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT in any language, or use your logo.

features.title: Your placement
features.text: Opacity, rotation, one of nine positions or repeated across the page, on all pages or a range.

stepsTitle: How to add a watermark to a PDF

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Design the watermark
steps.text: Type the text or choose a picture, then set size, colour, opacity and rotation.

steps.title: Place it
steps.text: Pick a position or repeat it across the page, and choose the pages. The preview shows the result.

steps.title: Add and download
steps.text: Click Add watermark, check the preview and download the PDF.

handles: Text: any words, Arabic included, in grey, red, blue or black.
Pictures: PNG, JPG or WebP logos, sized as a share of the page width.
Look: opacity from 10% to 100%, rotation of 0, 45, 90 or -45 degrees.
Placement: nine positions or tiled, on all pages or a page range.
limits: The watermark is drawn on top of the page; it can't be placed behind the existing content.
Text watermarks are drawn as pictures, so they can't be selected or searched.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be watermarked; remove the password first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can I use Arabic text?
faq.answer: Yes. The text is drawn by your browser, so Arabic letters join and run right to left as they should.

faq.question: Can someone remove the watermark?
faq.answer: It is drawn into the page content, so it is not a separate layer that can be switched off, but anyone with a PDF editor can still cover or cut it. A watermark marks a document; it does not lock it.

faq.question: Can the added text be selected or searched?
faq.answer: No. It is drawn as a sharp picture so Arabic letters join and run right to left correctly in every PDF app, which means it can't be selected, copied or searched.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark of ours and no limit on how often you use it.
